dc:description: One observed outcome-category percentage for a degree and connection-status series, within an ownership population and connection definition.
dc:title: Funding content profiles
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: connection_status: derived literal connected or remaining; value: connected_percent or remaining_percent according to connection_status; probability: connected_probability or remaining_probability; numerator: connected_category_n or remaining_category_n; denominator: connected_n or remaining_n; multi_response: NA38.multi_response; category_order: NA38.category_order; population_before_eligibility: NA39.population_n_before_outcome_eligibility; eligible_total_n: NA39.eligible_total_n; value_status: available for positive base and supplied value; otherwise unavailable; unavailable_reason: null when available; zero_denominator, unavailable_denominator, or not_provided_in_released_source when unavailable; interval_status: literal not_computed; interval_unavailable_reason: literal observed_description_no_interval
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
